snippet.title: Reincarnated Souls Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Reincarnated Souls is a top-down action shooter with RPG elements. 

Fight against deadly enemies and bosses who will have no mercy on your soul. If the road is very difficult, you can count on the help of your friends in a local network co-op(LAN).


You have reincarnated in a new world and you are given the mission to destroy the evil Soul Reaper. Defeat generals and forces of evil while gaining experience and power to complete your main mission.


Download now and start the adventure!!!

Play store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Nameless.ReincarnatedSouls

Twitter: @NamelessStudio3
